title: 032 candidate-only training: NNNC models trained only on windows whose last bar passes the gbb rule
label: PROVISIONAL -- one era (2023-26). No outcome is recorded as a FINDING (constitution II / gate 2): NNNC needs 730 training days and data starts 2021-01-01, so no distant-era window exists. A pass is PASS (PROVISIONAL), a provisional result with a forward-confirmation route.

setting.applied: after windowing, train AND validation; entry requires the same predicate; held-pair add off; 24 h grace (control snapshots)
setting.threshold: pick_threshold.py at target_rate 0.014735 (the controls' rate) on each fold's TRAINING window, ineligible bars counted as 0 (Clarification Q1: A)

stages.S1: mechanism gate, read first: within-candidate AUC (bars with guard_metric < 0.3 AND bb_width > 0.035; the model's own gbb_path label) of the retrained model minus the current model's, on IDENTICAL bars and labels from the fold test windows, > 0 in BOTH halves. A bootstrap 95% CI (pair-day blocks) is reported for information only. Reference (current model, research/model_calibration/within_candidates.json): ARO 0.618 / 0.601, GBR 0.591 / 0.583 (early / late) -- recomputed on the S1 bars, which is what is compared.
stages.S2: early half f00-f07, read only after S1 passes: arm early pp > width book early pp AND arm early pp > control early pp (pp = sum of per-fold return_pct, real arm records).
stages.S3: late half f08-f14 (confirmatory), read only after S2 passes: research.nnnc_switches.judge.judge_one(arm, control) == PASS (early gain > 0 AND late gain > 0 AND paired maps to pass AND both risk verdicts map to pass) AND arm late pp > width book late pp. judge_one(arm, width book) is REPORTED, not gated.

small_margin_rule: if S2 or S3 passes but any of its P&L margins (S2: arm-width early, arm-control early; S3: arm-width late, judge_one late_gain_pp vs control) is under 1.0 pp, that stage is INCONCLUSIVE until a paired seed-2 repeat (arm retrained and control model retrained on seed 2 over that stage's folds); it then passes only if every margin is > 0 on both seeds.
decision: per model: S1, S2 and S3 all pass -> PASS (PROVISIONAL); a stage fails -> FAIL (naming the stage; later stages not_reached); any arm fold with zero trades, or a mapped verdict inconclusive, or a stage held on the small-margin rule -> INCONCLUSIVE. The word 'adopted' is not used; promotion is the user's decision in any case.
confirmation_route: walk-forward folds after the data end 2026-09-07 once they exist, or dry-run data; only that can turn a PASS (PROVISIONAL) into a finding
reporting: S1 AUC by half (retrained, current, difference, CI)
early/late pp arm, control, width book
per-fold row_filter.json: kept share, class counts (SELL must be 0)
simulator recall/precision on the arm's entries (>= 0.95) and entry violations (must be 0)
order: T015 smoke (ARO f00 train only) -> ARO f01-f14 train -> pick thresholds -> co_aro backtest -> GBR train -> pick -> co_gbr backtest -> instrument checks -> S1 -> S2 -> S3
